Reconstructed the labelled sum-system/proper-factorization bijection, H_m(t)=m!t^m/prod_{j=1}^{m-1}(1-jt), the simple pole B_m=m/(m-1)^2 at t*=1/(m-1), and the independent multivariate marking T_S=Z_S(s)prod(1-u_p p^{-s})^{-1}-1. At Z_S(rho)=m/(m-1), alpha=-Z'_S(rho)>0, extracting total u-degree E gives exact Laurent coefficient B_m E! alpha^{-(E+1)} prod_p (Q_m p^{-rho})^{e_p}/e_p!. Distinct prime logarithms outside any finite S exclude all other boundary equality phases. Delange's nonnegative-Dirichlet-series theorem yields K/(rho Gamma(E+1)) X^rho(log X)^E, matching the claimed constant; rho<r_m yields divergence in probability of every fixed p-valuation. Independent standard-library integer enumeration separately matched all properly coloured ordered factorization words with Stirling-weighted factorization counts for 2<=m<=4 and 1<=n<=112. The finite checks prove coefficient normalization only, not unbounded asymptotics.
